statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was populated using the values from the supplementary reconciliation note 43(a). The values correspond to 'Depreciation of property, plant and equipment, investment properties and right-of-use assets' and 'Amortisation of intangible assets and land use rights' for each year, as these are the standard components of D&A. The numbers were extracted directly without summation, as per the schema requirement for an array.
